svg.title: Publication page: match the symbol to the action
svg.desc: Only action-symbol href changes from an upward upload arrow to a downward download arrow. The32×32 icon window, receiving-tray geometry, Download PDF label, button, metadata, fixed photo/crop, all font settings, screen, device and lighting remain identical. Original native SVG symbols; fictional static interface mockup, not an implemented download. Existing AI-generated photographic artwork reused unchanged; separate native typography and symbols.
svg.text: Only the declared symbol selection or label visibility changes. Imagery, typography and presentation stay fixed.
